title: Effectiveness of Topical Antibiotic Prophylaxis in Inguinal Hernia Repair
brief_summary: Aim of this study is to measure the effectiveness of topical gentamicin to prevent post-operative infection in inguinal tension-free hernia repair operation.Secondary aim is, if it is effective as a prophylactic agent, to compare it's effect with intra venous single dose cefazolin sodium prophylaxis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of inguinal hernia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Femoral hernia
* Emergency cases
